summary: Implementation plan for Primordial Tactics aligning the tactical survival game with the attached Game Design Document (GDD V1.1). Includes the interactive Island Liberation Campaign Map across multi-sector islands against the Evil Tribe, adoption of the document's 5 core combat classes (Blade, Skewer, Crush, Hulk, Human), and the Magitek Ancient Technology Research Lab unlocking cybernetic augments and advanced prehistoric gear.
